title: Positive Cubature Compression and Optimal Hyperinterpolation Stability on a Conic Surface
summary: We study the computational cost and stability of positive cubature and hyperinterpolation on a truncated conic surface with a Jacobi-type weight. A classical quadratic disk-to-cone map is formulated as a measure-preserving $\mathbb Z_2$ quotient. It identifies degree-$m$ conic traces with even disk polynomials of degree at most $2m$ and gives a two-way correspondence between positive degree-$2n$ cone cubature and centrally symmetric positive degree-$(4n+1)$ disk cubature.
